releases.name: v0.1.0 - Quota Board for OpenCode V2
releases.body:
## Know what's left. Keep building.

The first release of **Quota Board for OpenCode V2** puts provider quotas, reset countdowns, and credit balances right in your terminal.

**[Get it on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-quota-board/v/0.1.0)** · **[Full documentation](https://github.com/gilvex/opencode-quota-board#readme)**

![Live terminal recording: collapse and expand quotas, hide and show providers, open /quota, pin, refresh, and close](https://github.com/gilvex/opencode-quota-board/releases/download/v0.1.0/walkthrough.gif)

*A 32-second desktop recording of OpenCode 2.0.28 in Tabby on Windows, with real connected accounts and actual mouse/keyboard interactions. Screenshots are cropped from the recording; the GIF is resized for display. The original MP4 and four screenshots are attached below.*

**[Download the MP4 for Reddit/X](https://github.com/gilvex/opencode-quota-board/releases/download/v0.1.0/walkthrough.mp4)**

### What's included

- **Tree-style sidebar** with colored quota bars, balances, and collapsible providers.
- **Compact reset countdowns** like `OpenAI ▸ 98% · 6d 8h`.
- **A centered `/quota` popup** with provider cards, full-width meters, and refresh controls.
- **Persistent preferences** for provider visibility, pinning, and collapsed sections. The selected provider stays first.
- **A prompt-footer summary** for the selected provider; click it to open the popup.
- **V2-native account discovery**, using existing active connections and authenticated OpenCode Console access.
- **Resilient refreshing** with independent provider updates, request deduplication, retry backoff, and last-known readings marked **STALE** after failures.

### Quick install

Tested with **OpenCode 2.0.28**. Add this entry to the existing `plugins` array in **both** global files:

- `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` — server plugin
- `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` — terminal plugin

```json
{
  "plugins": ["opencode-quota-board@0.1.0"]
}
```

OpenCode installs the package for you. Run `opencode reload`, restart the TUI, and enter `/quota`. Connect accounts with `/connect` if needed. If using a remote server, configure the server plugin there; configuration paths follow `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` when set.

### Provider adapters

**OpenAI · Anthropic · OpenCode Console · OpenRouter · Z.AI Coding Plan · Synthetic · MiniMax Token Plan**

OpenAI and Anthropic subscription usage requires OAuth. Console combines readable credits and active Go/Go Plus windows. OpenRouter reports the current key's allowance, not an account-wide balance. Available readings depend on the provider, plan, and account permissions.

### Validation and feedback

- Typecheck, **11 unit tests**, and OpenTUI rendering/interaction checks passed.
- Both plugin entrypoints loaded successfully from a packed release installed in a clean consumer project.
- Live account checks confirmed **OpenAI quota data and OpenCode Console credits**. Feedback from users of the other providers is especially welcome.

This is an early release. Some provider endpoints are private and may change. Readings represent account allowances, not session spend; history and notifications are not included yet.

**[Report a bug or suggest an improvement](https://github.com/gilvex/opencode-quota-board/issues)** — include your OpenCode version, provider, and what happened.

If Quota Board helps your workflow, a GitHub star is appreciated. Thanks for trying it!
